_doc: NC-V2V3 · lệnh Wan2.2-VACE-Fun (tiếng Anh). Phần chung + phần mô tả clip CHỈ kể vật CÓ trong bản dựng nguồn (không gợi vật mới). Âm bản liệt kê vật hay bị bịa ở NC-V2V (lửa, khói, tàu, máy bay, sân vận động, quân, cờ).
chung: Photorealistic aerial documentary footage filmed from a helicopter with a real cinema camera. Real-world materials and natural light, soft atmospheric haze over distance, realistic textures. Same layout, same objects, same camera move as the control video; nothing added, nothing removed. Single continuous shot.

clip.c2: Clear late-morning daylight, 2026. The town of La Línea de la Concepción with low apartment blocks, terracotta tile roofs and flat roofs, streets, an airport runway on the flat sandy isthmus, the bay with calm blue sea water, and the limestone Rock of Gibraltar with green Mediterranean scrub.
clip.c4: Daylight, 1779. A flat sandy isthmus with dry grass, rows of military tents and earthworks of a siege camp, the calm sea on both sides, and the limestone Rock of Gibraltar in the distance.
clip.c1: Late afternoon light fading into night, 1782, following the control video exactly. The bay with burning floating batteries on the water, fire and smoke exactly where the control shows them, a fortified old town with terracotta tile roofs, the sea and the limestone shore.
clip.bcs: Daylight, 1782. Floating batteries firing at a fortified old town from the bay, white gun smoke drifting over the water exactly where the control shows it, a bastioned limestone fortress, houses with terracotta tile roofs, the sea.
clip.c1_v1_da_dung_cho_c1A_c1B: Night, 1782. The bay at night under moonlight, burning floating batteries on the water with bright fire and smoke exactly where the control shows them, a fortified old town with a few dim lamps, dark sea and the limestone Rock.
